text.tspan: SNS + SQS fan-out, S3 events to many queues, SNS FIFO, filtering
Fan-out: push once to SNS, every SQS queue gets it
Fully decoupled, no data loss; SQS adds persistence, delayed
processing, retries; add queues any time; works cross-Region.
One event type + prefix (e.g. object create, images/) = one
S3 event rule. Many targets for the same event → fan-out.
SNS to S3 through Data Firehose
SNS FIFO topic (+ SQS FIFO = fan-out with order)
• Ordering by Message Group ID; dedup by Deduplication ID
• Subscribers: SQS FIFO AND SQS Standard queues only
• 3,000 msg/s or 20 MB/s per topic (300/s per group);
SNS message filtering (subscription filter policy, JSON)
Scope: message attributes (default) or message body.
Your notes said "SQS - Message Filtering": it is SNS.
